system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

When you take damage from an attack, you can transmogrify yourself into your element and have it pass through you, potentially harming the attacking creature. As a reaction to taking damage from an attack while you are in your Elemental Flux, you may spend 1 Superiority Die, increasing your AC by the result until the end of the current turn. If the triggering and subsequent attacks are a melee attacks, you can also deal damage to the triggering creature(s) of a type equal to your Elemental Flux type until the end of the current turn. The damage dealt is equal to twice the result of your superiority die.
